mutation: where_clause: force status_filter=std::nullopt at entry (permissive: --status is silently ignored)
test: planar-watch run list --status filters both sources

mutation: run_list: replace 'if (arm == "wf" || arm == "all")' with 'if (true)' (permissive: wf source always included regardless of --arm)
test: planar-watch run list --arm restricts to one source

mutation: run_list: replace 'if (arm == "op" || arm == "all")' with 'if (true)' (permissive: op source always included regardless of --arm)
test: planar-watch run list --arm restricts to one source

mutation: run_show: neutralize the stage/created_at stable_sort comparator body to (void)a;(void)b; (permissive: id-insertion order survives, stage grouping never reorders)
test: planar-watch run show groups context_records by stage then created_at, id as tiebreak

mutation: event_matches: replace the --outcome comparison with 'if (false)' (permissive: --outcome never excludes a row)
test: planar-watch sync-events --outcome narrows; text count matches the filtered rows

mutation: link_belongs_to_plan: unconditional 'return true;' inserted at function entry (permissive: --plan/--system/--entity link-join filters never exclude a row)
test: planar-watch sync-events --plan / --system / --entity filter through the external_links join
